SHOPPING EXPERIENCE GIVE HELP DONATE FOOD DONATE MONEY VOLUNTEER NEWS LOCATIONS GALLERY CONTACT LOCATIONS Below are the opening times and locations of our foodbank centres (CLIENTS ONLY). Everyone who comes to the foodbank for emergency food needs to have a valid foodbank voucher . You can use your voucher at any location. FOOD DONATIONS: Please note that we are unfortunately unable to receive food donations at our foodbank centres. Please donate at our supermarket drop-off boxes . Thank you for your help with this. The Beacon Community Centre Clients only – no food donations please 07818 226 524 Beacon Lane Beacon Heath Exeter , EX4 8LZ Monday Closed Tuesday Closed Wednesday 10:00 am – 12:00 pm Thursday Closed Friday 10:00 am – 12:00 pm Saturday Closed Sunday Closed Exeter Foodbank, 174/175 Cowick Street Clients only – no food donations please 07818 226 524 174/175 Cowick Street Exeter , Devon EX4 1AA Monday 11:30 am – 2:00 pm Tuesday 11:30 am – 2:00 pm Wednesday 11:30 am – 2:00 pm Thursday 11:30 am – 2:00 pm Friday 11:30 am – 2:00 pm Saturday Closed Sunday Closed EX5 Alive Clients only – no food donations please 07818 226 524 Cranbrook Education Campus, Tillhouse Road, Cranbrook, Exeter , EX5 7EE Monday Closed Tuesday Closed Wednesday Closed Thursday 5:00 pm – 7:00 pm Friday Closed Saturday Closed Sunday Closed Contact us: If you have any questions, let us know.
